fusions.name: Branding Iron
fusions.desc: Presses a hot iron into the target for 28 fire damage, leaving it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 12 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Roped Stray
fusions.desc: Throws a rope loop over one enemy for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Pail
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Plough Calluses
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
